tasks.short: Compile a bibliography of specialized materials for outside reading assignments.

steps.what: Choose specialized materials for these outside reading assignments
Open each chosen work in the library catalogue
Review resolved titles for these art bibliographies

loop.input: The assignment brief the art teacher wrote: course, outside reading aim, and the art, music or drama focus.
loop.output: Candidate titles the library catalogue resolved, each with catalogue identifier, title, creator and year.
loop.check: A title is kept only when the library catalogue returns the same work, matched on title, creator and year, not merely an identifier shape. Any other title is dropped.
loop.stop: Stop when a suggested title does not resolve. The teacher finishes that title by hand. No unresolved title is kept.
loop.why_not_simpler: A catalogue search returns works the teacher already named. It does not propose which specialized score, script or monograph fits this assignment.

steps.what: Place citation lines into the bibliography draft
Compile annotated bibliographies for the outside reading assignments
Release the bibliographies on the course reading list
Send students the outside reading assignments note

tasks.design: The art teacher chooses the specialized materials for the assignment. A bounded loop suggests titles, and each title is kept only when the library catalogue returns the same work; the teacher writes the notes in the {DOCS} bibliography after reviewing a {SPREADSHEET} working list of resolved fields. The teacher then releases that bibliography on the {LMS} and sends a separate student note from {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: A suggested title could name a work that does not exist, and the catalogue match was a separate lookup the teacher retyped.
tasks.enabler_now: The library catalogue already returns identifier, title, creator and year, and the course site already holds the reading list.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding which specialized work a student should see, and writing why, stays with the teacher. Holdings the catalogue does not list still have to be typed.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher knows which score, script or recording this assignment needs. A resolved catalogue record does not make that choice.
tasks.altitude: The art teacher still chooses which specialized work a student should see. Citation lines are no longer retyped from the catalogue. They do not gain a right to publish a list they have not read.

reach.task: Find specialized scores, scripts and recordings in the collection
reach.learn: Which catalogue identifier stays stable for a score, a script and a recording

evidence.claim: A suggested title should be kept only when the catalogue returns the same work, including its title, creator and year.
Invented references pass plagiarism checks unflagged.
Annex III point 3 covers admission, evaluating learning outcomes, setting education level, and detecting cheating in tests.
Emotion inference in education has been banned since February 2025.
Art. 4 AI literacy covers all staff.

assumptions: Time shares follow the means: screens 0.8, spreadsheets 6.9, mail 3.1, documents 75.2 and in-person 13.9, summing to 99.9. Scaled by 100/99.9 with largest remainder, that is screens 1, spreadsheets 7, mail 3, documents 75 and in-person 14.
Of the 75 document points, 45 are citation lines, 25 are the teacher's notes on why a student should look, and 5 are placing the finished bibliography on the course site.

The in-person choice is not shortened. The library catalogue already exists and its runtime is not labour saved. About two thirds of the working-list step was retyping catalogue fields and chasing titles; the teacher still rejects a resolved work that does not fit, so about a third remains.
Catalogue fields are copied into the citation lines. The teacher still reads each citation line against the assignment, which is why that step remains at 55.

On release the teacher still reads the final bibliography. What shortens is retyping it onto the course page, so that step remains at 70. The student note still has the teacher's sentence; the course-site location is taken from the released list, so that step remains at 80.
Students are outside staff, so the course-site release and the student note are separate external acts. Each gate binds the version that leaves, not the citation draft or the notes.
Compiling a bibliography is outside the Annex III point 3 list. This design does not grade students, detect cheating, infer emotion, or record how the teacher edits the list.
Focal upkeep is zero because the catalogue check runs only when a bibliography is compiled, and that review is already inside the working-list step.
unknowns: Whether this employer's library catalogue stores a stable identifier for scores, scripts and recordings.
Whether the course site can take a bibliography without the teacher pasting it by hand.
research_questions: What share of a bibliography is citation lines versus the teacher's note on why the work fits?
How often does a suggested title fail to resolve in this catalogue?

already_counted.description: Rejecting a resolved work that does not fit the assignment.
Reading each citation line against the assignment before it stays in the draft.
Reading the final bibliography before it is released on the course site.

incremental.description: The art teacher does not gain a new weekly chore. The catalogue check runs only when a bibliography is compiled, and that review is already counted in the working-list step.

approvals.approved_version: released bibliography on the course site

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Catalogue fields land on the working list and the bibliography without retyping, and the course site releases that list. The teacher still chooses the works and writes why. Low when the specialized materials are manuscripts or local recordings the catalogue does not hold, so the teacher types them and most suggestions drop, or when the course site still needs the list pasted by hand. High when the catalogue already holds the scores, scripts, recordings and monographs and the suggestions resolve.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise a government body or an industry client, then send the note.

steps.what: Read the government or industry consulting request
Give professional consulting to government or industry
Write the professional consulting advice for the client
Send the consulting services text to the client

tasks.design: The art teacher reads the government or industry request in {EMAIL}, holds the consulting conversation, and writes the advice in {DOCS}. Only the text the teacher accepts is sent from {EMAIL}. The client's unpublished material is not passed to a model, and the conversation is not shortened.
tasks.previous_blocker: The advice sits in a conversation and a written note, and a wrong sentence to a government body or an industry client is hard to take back.
tasks.enabler_now: The mailbox already sends the note. The change is that only the text the teacher has just accepted is the text that goes.
tasks.still_hard: The conversation and the judgement of what to advise stay with the teacher.
tasks.human_edge: The client's situation and what the institution should commit to are the teacher's call.
tasks.altitude: The art teacher still holds the conversation and still decides what to advise. The week does not get shorter. The only change is that the text which leaves is the text they have just accepted.

evidence.claim: Advice sent to a government body or an industry client is hard to take back once it has left.

assumptions: The spreadsheet mean of 2.6 is omitted because this engagement does not keep a separate calculation table. The other means sum to 97.4. Scaled by 100/97.4 with largest remainder, that is screens 4, mail 10, documents 25 and in-person 61.
The screen share is reading the incoming request. The mail share is the advice that leaves. The conversation, the written advice and the reading of the request stay at full time.
The document is a draft the teacher can still change, so it is not gated. The send is its own step. The gate binds the text that is sent.
No model is used. The client's unpublished brief is not uploaded. The design does not grade anyone, detect cheating, infer emotion, or record how the teacher writes the note.
Focal upkeep is zero. No new system is introduced. The gate does not shorten the conversation or the note.
unknowns: Which government body or industry client this teacher actually advises, and whether that client expects only a conversation.
research_questions: How often does the written note change after the conversation, before it is sent?

already_counted.description: Reading the consulting text before it is sent to the client.

incremental.description: No extra chore and no model run is added. The teacher already reads the request, holds the conversation, writes the advice and sends it.

approvals.approved_version: consulting text sent to the client

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No step is shorter. The gate only stops an earlier text from leaving. The conversation, the written advice and the reading of the request stay at full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The art teacher still chooses the reading list and still gives the advice to government or industry. The catalogue match removes citation retyping. No new decision right is added.
skills_to_grow: Matching a suggested title to the catalogue work, not to an identifier shape
Keeping a client's unpublished brief out of a model
role.ambitious_version: The teacher still chooses every title and the advice. A course reading list the next cohort can start from is still the teacher's choice.

job.title: Art, Drama, and Music Teachers, Postsecondary
